admissionSummary.reason:
72-year-old male with COPD and hypertension admitted with community-acquired pneumonia, now day 2 on ceftriaxone and azithromycin with fever to 38.6°C overnight, WBC 15.1, right lower lobe infiltrate unchanged on CXR
• Community-acquired pneumonia — right lower lobe infiltrate on CXR, day 2 ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily and azithromycin 500 mg daily, fever 38.6°C overnight, plan to switch to oral antibiotics tomorrow
• Fever and leukocytosis — WBC 15.1 (up from 12.4), blood cultures drawn, no rigors
• Vital signs and oxygenation — BP 124/72, HR 98, RR 20, O2 93% on 2 L
• Renal function — creatinine 1.3, lactate 1.8

value.preRoundNotes: Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. 72-year-old man with COPD and hypertension admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. Overnight he spiked to 38.6, blood cultures were drawn, no rigors. This morning BP 124/72, HR 98, RR 20, O2 93% on 2 L. Labs: WBC 15.1 up from 12.4, creatinine 1.3, lactate 1.8. Chest X-ray shows the right lower lobe infiltrate unchanged. On ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily and azithromycin 500 mg daily, day 2. Home Toprol XL 50 mg daily, continue the metoprolol succinate. Plan: discuss switching to oral antibiotics tomorrow, follow up the blood cultures, repeat CBC in the morning.
radiology: Chest X-ray: right lower lobe infiltrate unchanged
